titleEn: Guest return by order number and phone

ar: العميل اشترى من غير حساب وعايز يرجع
en: A guest customer wants to return

edgeCases: Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Plan/feature not allowing it: API returns 403 FEATURE_DISABLED with an upgrade target when the plan is the cause; assistant must name the plan and link Billing, never imply a toggle
Concurrency: preview carries the etag/version read; if data changed before apply the assistant re-previews instead of applying
Team member lacking the permission gets 403: assistant states who can do it (store owner) instead of retrying
